Alumni Edition 2027

The Chopin competition for alumni of UNIL/EPFL, UZH/ETH and UNIGE

Register Help us organise

Who can take part?

The Alumni Edition is open to anyone who has studied at UNIL/EPFL, UZH/ETH Zürich or UNIGE.

How it works

1. First round: video

Submit a video of yourself performing a 5 to 15-minute programme including at least one composition by Chopin (other pieces may be by any composer), by 30 September 2027 at midnight. The person who registers must be the person in the video. The jury selects the finalists based on these recordings.

2. Inter-university Grand Final

In November or December 2027 (date and venue to be announced), in a concert hall, in public, in front of a jury of musicians. Finalists perform a 10 to 25-minute programme including at least one composition by Chopin, submit it in advance and must arrive at least one hour before their performance. Prizes are awarded to the laureates at the end of the final.

Judging criteria: technical ability, musicality and quality of interpretation, coherence and construction of the programme, and the interpretation of the Chopin work(s). The final may be filmed and photographed; by taking part, you agree that these recordings and images may be used by the organisers on the website, social media and platforms such as YouTube.
